note: Set A binds the table values correctly throughout: UV spectrometer R=7/Slit/grism/CCD201/1024, IR spectrometer 2×2 LMAPD, visible IFS 0.45–1.0 µm, and the starshade geometry figures (3 m central peak, 40 m smooth region, 40 m pronounced pattern, 24 petals), though it repeats several claims. Set B misreads the Spectrometers block of Table 5.5-3: it assigns 4,096, CCD282 and IFS to an 'unnamed' spectrometer (these are the Visible Channel spectrometer's), gives the Visible Channel spectrometer array width 1,024 (that is the camera value; the spectrometer is 4,096), detector 1×1 CCD201 (spectrometer is CCD282) and type Slit/grism (spectrometer is IFS). Both sets contain duplicate claims, but B's misbindings are substantive errors while A's claims are all supported.
